- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there (this chat is that app).
- **Messengers of my own** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write to and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **More** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk with you by voice.
